stage: Pre-capture design constraints; Mellow stackup confirmation and current-path calculation required before routing

classes.name: MotorPower
classes.nets: VMOTOR and motor phase outputs; planes/wider copper where needed

classes.name: Accessory5V
classes.nets: V5V; wide pours for combined servo load

classes.name: ClockMemoryDisplay
classes.nets: FLASH_*, XTAL_*, DISP_* and I2C; keep clocks over continuousGND

classes.name: SwitchSense
classes.nets: BUCK*_SW/BOOT and M*_SENSE_*; compact switch loops / separate Kelvin sense returns

localized_exceptions: 0.15mm width/clearance only for fine-pitch breakout, reviewed in PCB DRC. Package pad gaps are audited against actual footprints; never waive unrelated routing.
impedance_basis: USB starter geometry assumes0.18mm top dielectric,Er4.2,35um copper;approx90ohm. RF50ohm starter0.35mm over same dielectric. Recalculate with Mellow stackup before routing; these are not measured/guaranteed impedances.
routing_notes: Power widths are starting minima, not a5A or motor continuous-current qualification. Use short/wide pours and multiple vias.
Keep return plane continuous under USB/RF/clock/QSPI. Avoid switch-node copper below the antenna/crystal.
Do not place vias in0805 pads. Exposed-pad vias follow IC reference and Mellow assembly practice.
